ConfigurableProduct:17006.meta_description: Need a cute dog tag to match your dog's personality? Check out these Premium Dog Tags at Bright Star Buddies! You're sure to find something that fits pawfectly.
ConfigurableProduct:17006.faq:
How do I personalise my Dog Tag?

It's so easy and fun! Just choose your favourite design from our collection. Type your dog's name in the "front of tag" field then add your desired text at the back of the tag.

You can add up to 5 lines of text - just click the "+" symbol. If you need to remove a line of text, simply click the "-" symbol. Choose a font, and colour if applicable, and voilà! You may design and order as many as you like.

How do I attach my Dog Tag?

Each Dog Tag comes with a sturdy Split Ring, which works like a standard keyring. You can also buy a Collector Clasp, which makes switching out tags a breeze. Our Dog Tags can be easily attached to dog collars of all sizes.

How do I clean my Dog Tag?

If your Dog Tag gets dirty, don't stress! Rinse it off with warm soapy water and dry with a soft cloth. It'll be sparkling again in no time.

How is my Dog Tag made?

Our Dog Tags are directly printed onto a durable plastic material and finished by hand with a high-gloss coating that will keep them looking fabulous for years to come! This also means they're 100% waterproof, easy to clean and extremely hard-wearing.

Are these Dog Tags chew-resistant?

While these Premium Dog Tags are made from ultra-tough materials, they are not completely indestructible. Please remember they are not a toy, so don't allow your dogs to chew on them.
